conviction_note: Q1 (Jun-Aug) was pre-guided by the company itself as a quiet 'preparation period' before the 2,278m April order ships from Q2, the full-year plan equals the IFIS consensus (OP 1,599 vs 1,600) and the only order since (747m, 2026-09-18) is stated to be already in the plan, so the release is unlikely to add a revision; the name's two previous Q1 prints moved -0.99% and -0.75%, so abs_move is set near 2.5% (well under the 7.81% proxy, which is inflated by large-order days misread as print days) with p_up 49 and the findings summing to -0.1.
bar: FY2027.05 company plan sales 7,212m / OP 1,599m / ordinary 1,620m / dividend 55 yen (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260710591481.pdf), matched by IFIS consensus sales 7,300 / OP 1,600 / ordinary 1,600, unchanged over 4 weeks (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=7725). No quarterly or H1 plan is disclosed; the company's own Q1 guide is qualitative ('落ち着いて推移'). print_vs_bar 0 = full-year plan held, which is the expected outcome.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register 1.71% of shares (one seller), up 0.08pt from 1.63%, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via sealed baseline); 信用倍率 7.09 (crowded margin long, broker scrape); no options/skew. SilverCape Investments holds 18.00% (変更報告書 No.9, obligation date 2026-07-28, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7725&b=n202608041122), shrinking the float. priced_lean_pct +0.26. Run-up 20d +3.54%, 5d -2.19%.

findings.finding: The company's own FY2026 results presentation (2026-07-13/16) says Q1 FY2027 sales will be quiet ('第1四半期は…前期に受注した大口案件に向けた準備期間となること等から、落ち着いて推移する見込み') with the step-up from Q2, while R&D rises by about 200-300m yen for the year, so Q1 operating profit can print at or below last year's 99m and the kabutan auto-headline will likely read as a YoY decline or a very low progress rate (Q1 OP progress was 57% in FY25 and 14% in FY26).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 prints: 2024-10-11 -0.99% (with an upward full-year revision, kabutan '上方修正も買い続かず'), 2025-10-10 -0.75% (Q1 ordinary -83% YoY). Close-to-next-close from the Yahoo chart.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the company told the market in July that Q1 would be quiet, so the miss was flagged before this print and nobody holding the stock at 1,790 is expecting a strong Q1. What is left is the crowded margin long (信用倍率 7.09) reacting to a headline YoY decline; if that were priced the stock would have been weakening into the print, and it has drifted only -2.19% over 5 sessions.
findings.independence: R&D increase from the Q&A, a different document but the same company and the same guidance set: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260716/140120260716595149.pdf

findings.finding: No full-year revision trigger is visible: the only large order since the plan (747m yen of image-sensor inspection products, booked 2026-09-18, recognised Q2-Q4) is stated to be '2027年5月期通期連結業績予想に織り込み済み', the IFIS consensus sits on the plan, and the IoT order backlog entering the year was 2,646m (+170% YoY) against a 5,100m segment sales plan, so the plan is held and the print adds little at the forecast line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revisions at Q1 happened in 2 of the last 3 years (2023-10-12 and 2024-10-11 per kabutan's 修正履歴); the 2024-10-11 upward revision was sold (-0.99%). H1 prints with upward revisions bought: 2025-01-10 +7.96%, 2026-01-09 +6.67%. The 2026-09-18 order itself moved +2.36% close-to-close.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the order was announced with the explicit statement that it is already in the plan and the stock took +2.4% on it and then gave it back. Sized at 0 because the expected release is a held plan; the band's upside is the chance of an early raise, which the company's own 'quiet Q1' language makes unlikely at this print.
findings.independence: IFIS consensus equal to the plan: https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=7725 ; backlog table in the FY tanshin: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260710591481.pdf

findings.finding: The new FY2027-29 cash allocation keeps 2,500m yen for shareholder returns with 'DOE4%以上…特別配当の実施、機動的な自己株式取得' after a ~1,000m buyback in FY2026, on 8.5bn yen of cash against an ~18bn market cap and an 18% holder (SilverCape) that has been adding; a buyback announced in the same TDnet batch is possible but has not been signalled.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-07-11 buyback of up to 1.2m shares announced with FY results: kabutan '３日ぶり反発' intraday, 0.00% close-to-next-close on the release date.
findings.why_not_priced: A buyback at a Q1 print would be new; the company has announced its last buyback with full-year results, not with a Q1, so the probability is low and the size here is the probability-weighted value, not a call that one comes.
findings.independence: SilverCape stake 18.00%: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7725&b=n202608041122 (a holder that could press for returns, not evidence a buyback is coming).

outside_window.finding: Q2-Q3 recognition of the 2,278m April order and the 747m September order; the step-up the company guides from Q2 will show at the H1 print (January 2027), where this name's revisions have historically moved it +6.7% to +8.0%.

searched_and_found_nothing: TDnet/kabutan disclosure list for 7725 since 2026-07-13: no 業績予想の修正 or 配当予想の修正 filed before the print (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7725)
No large order (>=500m threshold since 2025-08-22) announced in Q1 Jun-Aug 2026, so Q1 order intake is base orders only; the only new one is 2026-09-18 (Q2)
No quarterly consensus or 会社四季報 Q1 number found; IFIS full-year consensus equals the plan
Did not identify the overseas main customer, so no independent customer-side series for the image-sensor test-equipment cycle
Company IR site not fetched (documents read via kabutan's TDnet PDF mirror instead)
release_time_source: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260925/140120260925540255.pdf (決算発表日時は2026年10月13日15時30分以降を予定); prior prints stamped 16:00 at https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7725
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: not expected (only new order is 'in the plan'; consensus = plan), revised at Q1 in FY24 and FY25 but not FY26. Returns: dividend 55 (incl. 10 special) already set; a buyback is possible under the cash allocation but unsignalled. New-year guide: n/a at Q1. Quarter: company pre-guided Q1 as quiet; Q1 OP progress was 57% (FY25) and 14% (FY26), so no stable seasonal norm, and this year's guided shape is back-loaded.

rejected_candidates.candidate: April 2026 order notice says the 2,278m order is recognised from June 2026 (Q1), implying a strong Q1
rejected_candidates.detail: The later 2026-07-13/16 results presentation says Q1 is a preparation period for that order and sales will be quiet, with the contribution from Q2.

Several estimated event dates are large-order days (e.g. 2026-04-09 +11.11% is the 2026-04-08 order, not the 04-10 print); on the actual TDnet print dates the median absolute next-day move is about 2.9% and the two Q1 prints were -0.99% and -0.75%.

baseline_tension: Agrees with a flat lean (priced_lean +0.26, run-up 20d +3.5%, 5d -2.2%). Strongest positive the release could carry: an early plan raise or a buyback in the same batch, both looked for and neither signalled; strongest negative: a headline YoY Q1 decline hitting a 7.09 margin-long book, but the company pre-flagged it, so the net is near zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on what the market already has): the weak-Q1 finding rests on the company's own public July guidance, so it moved from -0.5 to -0.3 and p_up from 47 to 49.
Rule 2 (check the sign): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension (held plan, possible buyback) and confirmed both were searched; no further change.
